tag: Intro: Spoken Narrator, plucked strings, ticking clock

lines.text: Nineteen ninety-two. A desert world. A spice to mine.
lines.speaker: Spoken Narrator

lines.text: A team out in Vegas drew the blueprint for the grind:
lines.speaker: Spoken Narrator

lines.text: Harvest. Build. Expand. Attack. And do it all in real time.
lines.speaker: Spoken Narrator

lines.text: Thirty years later, we're still running that design.
lines.speaker: Spoken Narrator

lines.text: Build order! (Build order!)
lines.speaker: Ensemble Chant

lines.text: Gather and expand!
lines.speaker: Ensemble Chant

lines.text: Build order! (Build order!)
lines.speaker: Ensemble Chant

lines.text: The whole world at your command!
lines.speaker: Ensemble Chant

lines.text: I was ten with a Pentium, a beige tower, modem screamin',
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: CRT glow on my face till three a.m., still dreamin',
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: floppy disks in a shoebox, a mouse with a ball inside,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: one click and a whole battalion moves, I'm along for the ride!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: Dune Two was the founding father, harvesters out on the sand,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: a sandworm ate my tank whole and I didn't understand,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: but I learned it: you can't win a war if you can't feed it,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: gotta mine before you fight, gotta build it 'fore you need it!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: Fog of war on the border, nothing on the map,
lines.speaker: Ensemble

lines.text: just a town hall and a worker and a clock that won't stop...
lines.speaker: Ensemble

lines.text: One more game! (One more game!)
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Mom is yelling down the stairs, but I'm one more game!
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Rush 'em, tower, turtle, tech it late,
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: every empire in history was "one more game!"
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: One more game! (One more game!)
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Sun is coming up and I'm still one more game!
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Not gonna stop till the fog of war is lifted,
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: gimme the map, gimme the mouse, gimme one more game!
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

tag: Verse 2: Gruff Male Rapper, war drums, brass

lines.text: Ninety-five! Tides of Darkness! Orcs on the shore!
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: Humans in the castle and we're kicking down the door!
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: Peons in the gold mine, "Zug zug!", chopping the wood,
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: chop the whole forest flat 'cause the lumber's looking good!
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: Ogre-magi bloodlust, catapults up on the hill,
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: death knights raise the dead and the dead don't stand still,
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: click a sheep too many times and the sheep goes boom,
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

lines.text: that's the kind of game design that'll follow you to the tomb!
lines.speaker: Gruff Male Rapper

tag: Verse 3: Male Lead Rapper, industrial guitars, aggressive

lines.text: Construction complete.
lines.speaker: Robotic Female Voice

lines.text: Westwood dropped the hammer with a live-action screen,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: a bald man in the briefing room, Tiberium glowing green,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: "Peace through power!" Brotherhood of Nod,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: GDI up in orbit with an ion cannon like a god,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: harvester hauling crystals like a cash machine,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: Mammoth tanks rolling over everything in between,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: engineer slips through the wall in the dead of night,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: now your Obelisk is mine and it's firing on your light!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

lines.text: Unit ready. Unit lost.
lines.speaker: Robotic Female Voice

lines.text: Then Red Alert rewrote the timeline, Tesla coils and Soviet red!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper

tag: Verse 4: Female Rapper, harpsichord and strings, regal

lines.text: Ninety-seven, Ensemble took the history books for a spin,
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: Stone Age, Tool Age, Bronze, Iron, let the ages begin!
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: Villagers on the berries, fishing boats along the coast,
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: twelve civs of the ancient world, so who's gonna build the most?
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: Priest in a robe goes "Wololo!" Now your army's mine,
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: I converted your elephants, crossed the river, held the line,
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: typed "Photon Man" in the chat, laser trooper in a toga,
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: then the Age of Kings rolled trebuchets and your castle walls are over!
lines.speaker: Female Rapper

lines.text: One more game! (One more game!)
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Mom is yelling down the stairs, but I'm one more game!
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: Rush 'em, tower, turtle, tech it late,
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

lines.text: every empire in history was "one more game!"
lines.speaker: Full Ensemble

tag: Verse 5: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines, fastest flow

lines.text: Ninety-eight! Now the sky splits three ways in the dark,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: Terran grit! Zerg swarm! Protoss gold and a psionic spark!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: "SCV, good to go, sir!" Zerglings, six-pool rush!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: Pylon down, you must construct additional... hush!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: Not enough minerals! Insufficient vespene gas!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: Battle.net past midnight and the ladder is a class,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: then Seoul made it a stadium sport, Brood War on TV,
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: three hundred actions a minute, that's a symphony!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: Nuclear launch detected.
lines.speaker: Robotic Female Voice

lines.text: Find the ghost! Too late!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

lines.text: En Taro Adun, GG, and I'm queuing one more game!
lines.speaker: Male Lead Rapper and Female Rapper trading lines

tag: Bridge: Sung, slower, piano and strings, tender

lines.text: We hauled CRTs down the basement stairs,
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: forty pounds of glass and a tangle of wires,
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: pizza and a hub that barely worked,
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: eight kids, one LAN, nobody slept, nobody shirked.
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: And the games got old, and the pixels faded out,
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: but every kid who built a base knows what the fight's about:
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: you gather what you've got, you build it up from none,
lines.speaker: Sung

lines.text: and you never, ever quit until the last game's done.
lines.speaker: Sung

tag: Final Chorus: Key change, full choir, all voices

lines.text: One more game! (One more game!)
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: Mom is yelling down the stairs, but I'm one more game!
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: Rush 'em, tower, turtle, tech it late,
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: every empire in history was "one more game!"
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: One more game! (One more game!)
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: Sun is coming up and we're still one more game!
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: Not gonna stop till the fog of war is lifted,
lines.speaker: Key change

lines.text: gimme the map, gimme the mouse, gimme one more game!
lines.speaker: Key change

tag: Outro: Call and response, drums drop out

lines.text: Build order?
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: (Workers first!)
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: Scout the map?
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: (Find 'em first!)
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: Hold the line?
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: (Never break!)
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: And when it's over?
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: (One more game.)
lines.speaker: Call and response

lines.text: GG.
lines.speaker: Spoken, quiet
